# AI Policy

We welcome contributions from anyone, including people who use AI tools.

However, we are volunteers. To protect our limited time and attention, we ask
that all issues, pull requests, and comments come from a human who understands
and takes responsibility for their contribution. AI can assist, but it shouldn't
be the one asking for our attention.

We do not allow unreviewed or fully autonomous contributions. If we wanted to
prompt an AI or automate something, we could do that ourselves!
